query: I am a student moving to Finland from a non-EU country to study a 3-year bachelor's degree. Am I eligible for any social security benefits or a Kela card?
expected_answer: If you move to Finland from a non-EU country and your studies last for two years or more, Kela can take the view that you have moved to Finland permanently. In this case, you may be eligible for some residence-based Kela benefits (such as coverage if you fall ill or have a child) and you can get a Kela card. However, you generally cannot get student financial aid unless you have another qualifying basis.

query: I just moved to Finland for a temporary 1-year work contract. What are the requirements for me to get a Kela card and social security coverage?
expected_answer: You can qualify for Kela benefits and a Kela card on the basis of employment if you work in Finland and your wages or salary amount to at least EUR 800.02 per month. If this wage threshold is met, you can get certain benefits (such as sickness allowance) starting from the day your employment begins, regardless of how long you stay.

query: I recently lost my job in Finland. I heard there is a new unemployment system starting in May 2026. What unemployment benefit can I apply for from Kela, and how much is it?
expected_answer: As of 1 May 2026, Kela pays a new 'general social security benefit' (yleistuki) to unemployed jobseekers, which has replaced the former labour market subsidy and basic unemployment allowance. The general social security benefit rate is EUR 37.21 per day, which averages about EUR 800.02 per month. This benefit is subject to means-testing against your earned and capital income.

query: I came to Finland to study a degree. Can I apply for the Kela study grant and housing supplement to help cover my rent?
expected_answer: Generally, students who move to Finland from abroad solely for the purpose of studying are not entitled to student financial aid (which includes the study grant, student loan guarantee, and housing supplement). To qualify for student financial aid as a non-Finnish citizen, your residence in Finland must be considered permanent on some other qualifying basis, such as employment or family ties.

query: I am applying for Kela benefits for the first time since relocating to Finland. Do I need to submit any specific forms to register my move with Kela?
expected_answer: Yes. If you are applying for Kela benefits for the first time after moving to Finland, you must notify Kela of your move. You can file this notification online in the OmaKela e-service, or by filling out and submitting paper form Y 77e ('Moving to Finland or employment in Finland') to Kela along with your application.

query: I am an international student. If I experience financial difficulties and apply for basic social assistance (toimeentulotuki) from Kela, will this affect my residence permit?
expected_answer: Yes. Under legislative amendments proposed by the Finnish Government, the residence permit of a student from outside the EU/EEA or Switzerland may be withdrawn or denied if they receive social assistance (toimeentulotuki). International students are expected to be fully self-sufficient and cover their living costs independently.
